content: {"like":["Effective use of background music that enhances scenes without drawing attention","High tension and serious tone that keeps viewers engaged in the half‑hour format","Decent black‑and‑white video quality with excellent sound","Realistic wardrobe choices, such as heavy jackets appropriate for the northern setting","Consistent and clean appearance of main actors, contributing to a polished look"],"dislike":["Dan Troop frequently addressing his deputy as “Boy,” which feels derogatory","The artificial white hair streaks on John Russell, appearing unnatural","Over‑reliance on drunken saloon patrons as the main source of violence","Exaggerated and unconvincing macho egos leading to tragic outcomes","Occasional unintended humor that feels out of place","One episode (“The Press”) recorded at a higher volume level than others","Overall lack of effective comedy, with most attempts falling flat","Heavy jackets worn too often, and actors’ outfits appearing too pristine and unchanged"]}
